raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

**What goes wrong**
On gfx1250, `apply_unquantized_linear` sends bf16 linears to `aiter.tuned_gemm.tgemm.mm`, whose default solution is the gluon `_gemm_a16w16_gfx1250_bandwidth_bound_kernel`. That kernel indexes the output with 32-bit byte offsets, so every output row whose byte offset is at or past 2**31 comes back as garbage, with no fault and no error. The existing guard bounds element count (`numel < 2**31`), not bytes, so it lets these shapes through.

**Where it shows up**
Any gfx1250 diffusion linear whose bf16 output exceeds 2 GiB. On Wan2.2-T2V-A14B at 720p (90000 tokens per DiT forward), the FFN up-projection output is 90000 x 13824 x 2 B = 2.49 GB, so rows 77672..89999, the last latent frame, are corrupted in every block of every step. The decoded video's final frame is pure noise. Checked against an fp32 reference: rows below 77672 match to 0.016 max abs error; rows from 78000 on are off by 7.2 to 7.3. The FFN down-projection (2.5 GB input, 0.9 GB output) is unaffected, so it is the output offset. Only gfx1250 was checked; other archs reach tgemm through different kernels.

**How to fix**
On gfx1250, route large-M bf16 linears to aiter's FlyDSL `gemm_a16w16_gfx1250`, which addresses through TDM descriptors and is correct past 2 GiB, and on gfx1250 lower the remaining tgemm fallback's bound to 2**31 bytes.

## Modifications

- `python/sglang/multimodal_gen/runtime/layers/linear.py`
  - New gfx1250 path: bf16 linears with M >= 4096, N % 256 == 0, K % 64 == 0 call `aiter.ops.flydsl.gemm_a16w16_gfx1250.gemm_a16w16` with tile 256x256x64, 2x4 waves, 4 LDS buffers, `variant="compute_bound"` (the best correct config from a sweep at the Wan2.2 shapes). It is registered as an opaque custom op (`diffusion_flydsl_gfx1250_linear`) so torch.compile does not trace the FlyDSL JIT.
  - On gfx1250 only, the remaining tgemm fallback is bounded at 2**30 elements (2**31 bytes of bf16/fp16) instead of 2**31, so shapes that miss the FlyDSL path fall back to `F.linear` instead of silently corrupting. Every other arch keeps the existing 2**31-element bound, so MI300/MI355 dispatch is unchanged.
  - Small-M linears (text tokens, timestep embeddings) keep using tgemm. CUDA never enters either path (`_USE_AITER_TGEMM` is False there).
- `test/registered/unit/multimodal_gen/test_linear_tgemm_size_bound.py` (new, CPU, `base-a-test-cpu`): with meta tensors and a mocked tgemm, on gfx1250 the Wan2.2 FFN-up shape never reaches `tgemm.mm` while a 512-row linear still does, and on other archs the same large shape still reaches tgemm.
- `python/sglang/multimodal_gen/test/unit/test_gfx1250_linear_dispatch.py` (new, gfx1250 only, skipped elsewhere): the FFN-up shape through `apply_unquantized_linear` matches an fp32 reference on rows past the 2 GiB boundary.

## Accuracy Tests

sgl-eval does not cover video diffusion, so correctness is shown at the kernel and output-frame level.

| check | before (tgemm) | after (FlyDSL) |
|---|---|---|
| FFN-up 90000x13824x5120, max abs err vs fp32, rows < 77672 | 0.016 | 0.016 |
| FFN-up 90000x13824x5120, max abs err vs fp32, rows >= 78000 | **7.2 - 7.3** | 0.016 |
| Wan2.2 720p 193-frame video, last frame | pure noise | coherent scene |

Wan2.2 output is bit-exact run to run on the baseline (138 dB PSNR between two runs), so any kernel change, including this one, shifts the whole trajectory (13 dB mean PSNR vs baseline); the regression signal is the last frame, not PSNR.

## Benchmarking and Profiling

One gfx1250 DPX half-partition (96 CU), sibling partition idle, `SGLANG_USE_ROCM_AITER_TGEMM=1 HIP_FORCE_DEV_KERNARG=0`, Wan2.2-T2V-A14B, 720x1280, 8 steps, 90000 tokens per forward, BF16 attention (`--attention-backend aiter`), no torch.compile.

GEMM, M = 90000, bf16 with bias (the 5120-wide rows were timed while the sibling partition ran a Wan2.2 job, so their absolute TFLOPS are pessimistic; the ratio is same-condition):

| N x K | tgemm (gluon) | FlyDSL (this PR) | speedup |
|---|---|---|---|
| 5120 x 5120 (QKV / O) | 5.85 ms, 806 TFLOPS | 4.93 ms, 958 TFLOPS | 1.19x |
| 13824 x 5120 (FFN up) | 14.45 ms, 882 TFLOPS (wrong rows) | 13.43 ms, 946 TFLOPS | 1.08x |
| 5120 x 13824 (FFN down) | 16.67 ms, 764 TFLOPS | 14.80 ms, 861 TFLOPS | 1.13x |

End to end (`sglang generate`, `[DenoisingStage] average time per step`):

| | s / denoise step | e2e |
|---|---|---|
| before | 24.52 | 221.1 s |
| after | 24.04 | 218.9 s |

Note: these runs used 90000 tokens per forward (a local VAE `scale_factor_temporal = 8`); the upstream Wan2.2 config (factor 4, 176400 tokens) makes the outputs about 2x larger, so it crosses 2 GiB on more linears and the fix matters more there. The 176400-token config was not run.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Review Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the PR flow. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.
   - `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci`, `/tag-and-rerun-ci`
4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls to merge.

files.patch:
@@ -39,15 +39,86 @@
 
 # yapf: enable
 from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.utils.weight_attrs import set_weight_attrs
+from sglang.srt.utils import is_gfx1250_supported
+from sglang.srt.utils.custom_op import register_custom_op
 
 logger = init_logger(__name__)
 
 IS_AMP_SUPPORTED = current_platform.is_amp_supported()
 _USE_AITER_TGEMM = current_platform.is_rocm() and envs.SGLANG_USE_ROCM_AITER_TGEMM
 if _USE_AITER_TGEMM:
     from aiter.tuned_gemm import tgemm
-# aiter gemm_a16w16 kernels index operands with int32 offsets and fault beyond this.
-_AITER_TGEMM_MAX_NUMEL = 2**31
+_IS_GFX1250_TGEMM = _USE_AITER_TGEMM and is_gfx1250_supported()
+
+
+def _aiter_tgemm_max_numel() -> int:
+    # aiter gemm_a16w16 kernels index operands with int32 offsets and fault beyond this.
+    # On gfx1250 the offset is in bytes and output rows past 2**31 bytes come back
+    # wrong (no fault), so the 16-bit element bound there is 2**30.
+    return 2**30 if _IS_GFX1250_TGEMM else 2**31
+
+
+# On gfx1250 the FlyDSL a16w16 GEMM indexes through TDM descriptors (no int32 byte
+# limit) and beats tgemm's gluon kernel by 7-18% on large-M DiT linears.
+_USE_FLYDSL_GFX1250_GEMM = _IS_GFX1250_TGEMM
+if _USE_FLYDSL_GFX1250_GEMM:
+    from aiter.ops.flydsl.gemm_a16w16_gfx1250 import (
+        gemm_a16w16 as flydsl_gemm_a16w16_gfx1250,
+    )
+# Tile config swept at Wan2.2 shapes (M=90000, N/K in {5120, 13824}).
+_FLYDSL_GFX1250_TILE_M, _FLYDSL_GFX1250_TILE_N, _FLYDSL_GFX1250_TILE_K = 256, 256, 64
+_FLYDSL_GFX1250_NUM_BUFFERS = 4
+_FLYDSL_GFX1250_MIN_M = 4096
+
+
+def _flydsl_gfx1250_linear_fake(
+    x: torch.Tensor, weight: torch.Tensor, bias: torch.Tensor | None
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    return x.new_empty((x.shape[0], weight.shape[0]))
+
+
+@register_custom_op(
+    op_name="diffusion_flydsl_gfx1250_linear",
+    mutates_args=[],
+    fake_impl=_flydsl_gfx1250_linear_fake,
+)
+def _flydsl_gfx1250_linear(
+    x: torch.Tensor, weight: torch.Tensor, bias: torch.Tensor | None
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    # Opaque custom op: FlyDSL's JIT reads thread-local MLIR state Dynamo can't trace.
+    return flydsl_gemm_a16w16_gfx1250(
+        x,
+        weight,
+        bias,
+        dtype=x.dtype,
+        tile_m=_FLYDSL_GFX1250_TILE_M,
+        tile_n=_FLYDSL_GFX1250_TILE_N,
+        tile_k=_FLYDSL_GFX1250_TILE_K,
+        m_warp=2,
+        n_warp=4,
+        num_buffers=_FLYDSL_GFX1250_NUM_BUFFERS,
+        variant="compute_bound",
+    )
+
+
+def _can_use_flydsl_gfx1250_linear(
+    x: torch.Tensor, weight: torch.Tensor, bias: torch.Tensor | None
+) -> bool:
+    n, k = weight.shape
+    return (
+        _USE_FLYDSL_GFX1250_GEMM
+        and x.dtype == torch.bfloat16
+        and weight.dtype == x.dtype
+        and (bias is None or bias.dtype == x.dtype)
+        and x.numel() // k >= _FLYDSL_GFX1250_MIN_M
+        and n % _FLYDSL_GFX1250_TILE_N == 0
+        and k % _FLYDSL_GFX1250_TILE_K == 0
+        and k // _FLYDSL_GFX1250_TILE_K >= _FLYDSL_GFX1250_NUM_BUFFERS
+        and x.stride(-1) == 1
+        and weight.is_contiguous()
+    )
+
+
 WEIGHT_LOADER_V2_SUPPORTED = [
     "CompressedTensorsLinearMethod",
     "AWQMarlinLinearMethod",
@@ -178,13 +249,17 @@ def apply_unquantized_linear(
             None if bias is None else bias.to(torch.float32),
         ).to(x.dtype)
 
+    if _can_use_flydsl_gfx1250_linear(x, weight, bias):
+        out = _flydsl_gfx1250_linear(x.reshape(-1, x.shape[-1]), weight, bias)
+        return out.view(*x.shape[:-1], weight.shape[0])
+
     if (
         _USE_AITER_TGEMM
         and x.dtype in (torch.bfloat16, torch.float16)
         and weight.dtype == x.dtype
         and (bias is None or bias.dtype == x.dtype)
-        and x.numel() < _AITER_TGEMM_MAX_NUMEL
-        and x.numel() // x.shape[-1] * weight.shape[0] < _AITER_TGEMM_MAX_NUMEL
+        and x.numel() < _aiter_tgemm_max_numel()
+        and x.numel() // x.shape[-1] * weight.shape[0] < _aiter_tgemm_max_numel()
     ):
         return tgemm.mm(x, weight, bias)

@@ -0,0 +1,38 @@
+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+"""On gfx1250, bf16 linears whose output passes 2**31 bytes must stay correct.
+
+aiter's tgemm writes wrong values, without faulting, to output rows past 2**31 bytes;
+at Wan2.2 720p that turned the last decoded video frame into noise."""
+
+import unittest
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.layers import linear
+from sglang.srt.utils import is_gfx1250_supported
+
+# Wan2.2 A14B 720p FFN up-projection: the output is 2.49 GB, past 2**31 bytes.
+M, N, K = 90000, 13824, 5120
+
+
+class TestGfx1250LargeOutputLinear(unittest.TestCase):
+    def test_rows_past_2gib_output_match_fp32_reference(self):
+        if not (linear._USE_AITER_TGEMM and is_gfx1250_supported()):
+            pytest.skip("needs gfx1250 with SGLANG_USE_ROCM_AITER_TGEMM=1")
+        torch.manual_seed(0)
+        x = torch.randn(M, K, device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+        w = torch.randn(N, K, device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16) / K**0.5
+        b = torch.randn(N, device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+        out = linear.apply_unquantized_linear(x, w, b)
+        # Row 77672 is the first whose output byte offset crosses 2**31.
+        rows = torch.cat([torch.arange(0, 128), torch.arange(M - 12000, M - 11872)])
+        rows = rows.cuda()
+        ref = x[rows].float() @ w.float().t() + b.float()
+        torch.testing.assert_close(out[rows].float(), ref, atol=0.05, rtol=0.02)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    import sys
+
+    sys.exit(pytest.main([__file__, "-v"]))

@@ -0,0 +1,50 @@
+"""Diffusion linears must not reach aiter tgemm past its gfx1250 int32 byte-offset limit.
+
+On gfx1250, tgemm writes wrong values, without faulting, to output rows past 2**31
+bytes; at Wan2.2 720p that turned the last decoded video frame into noise. Off
+gfx1250 the size bound is unchanged."""
+
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=5, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+import unittest
+from unittest.mock import MagicMock, patch
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.layers import linear
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+# Wan2.2 A14B 720p FFN up-projection: 1.24e9 bf16 outputs = 2.49 GB.
+M, N, K = 90000, 13824, 5120
+
+
+def _route(is_gfx1250: bool, m: int) -> MagicMock:
+    tgemm = MagicMock()
+    x = torch.empty(m, K, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device="meta")
+    w = torch.empty(N, K, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device="meta")
+    with (
+        patch.object(linear, "_USE_AITER_TGEMM", True),
+        patch.object(linear, "_IS_GFX1250_TGEMM", is_gfx1250),
+        # Isolate the tgemm bound from the large-M FlyDSL route.
+        patch.object(linear, "_USE_FLYDSL_GFX1250_GEMM", False),
+        patch.object(linear, "tgemm", tgemm, create=True),
+    ):
+        linear.apply_unquantized_linear(x, w)
+    return tgemm
+
+
+class TestTgemmSizeBound(CustomTestCase):
+    def test_gfx1250_output_past_2gib_skips_tgemm(self):
+        self.assertFalse(_route(is_gfx1250=True, m=M).mm.called)
+
+    def test_gfx1250_small_output_keeps_tgemm(self):
+        self.assertTrue(_route(is_gfx1250=True, m=512).mm.called)
+
+    def test_other_archs_keep_tgemm_for_same_shape(self):
+        self.assertTrue(_route(is_gfx1250=False, m=M).mm.called)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
